name: Donna T. Gibbs
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Oakland, California
education: Santa Clara University School of Law
about: Donna is a Certified Family Law Specialist and a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers. She has been a member of the California bar since 1997 and has exclusively practiced family law since 1999. Donna has been recognized as the 2022 Lawyer of the Year in Oakland by Best Lawyers in America and has been named a Super Lawyer in the area of family law every year since 2008.

Donna’s practice currently focuses on providing mediation services as a mediator, and representing clients in mediation, collaborative divorce, and litigation. Donna handles complex family law matters through all stages of negotiation or litigation. Donna enjoys her mediation practice and serving in a neutral role to help clients reach a negotiated resolution out of court.

Donna earned her bachelor’s degree from the University of California, Santa Cruz, and her Juris Doctor from Santa Clara University School of Law. Prior to practicing family law, she worked as a public defender in Stanislaus County.

Donna is an active and long-standing member of the community. She was born in Riga, Latvia but has lived in the Bay Area since 1978. She raised two children in the Bay Area and is experienced in addressing the issues facing families in the Bay Area.
